title: EPUB sharing launches a chooser without a new-task flag
reasoning: HistoryViewModel injects an ApplicationContext, so any activity launch needs FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK on the exact Intent passed to startActivity. shareDigest puts the flag on the nested ACTION_SEND intent, then wraps it in a new chooser Intent and starts that chooser without adding FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK. On devices that enforce the application-context launch contract, sharing fails with an AndroidRuntimeException that is caught and surfaced as an error instead of opening the share sheet.
reproduction: Call shareDigest for an existing EPUB from HistoryViewModel; the chooser Intent created at line 156 is the launched intent and does not carry FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK.
recommendation: Create the chooser in a local variable, add FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK and FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION to the chooser or launch from an Activity context/event owned by the UI layer.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided, and a repo search found no HistoryViewModel or share intent tests.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Robolectric or intent-factory unit test asserting the launched chooser Intent includes FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK when shareDigest is invoked with an ApplicationContext.
